31 rescued monkeys NEED YOU

Snatched from their mums as babies. Starved and beaten as training. Forced to wear masks and dressed up as dolls for human entertainment. Kind people like you helped rescue these 31 monkeys from the horrors of the entertainment industry. Now they need your help to recover from their ordeal and live the life they deserve – a life in the wild.

Will you donate now to help give 31 rescued monkeys a second chance at a wild life?
